checks: Independent portable practice attempts start with classic PVST, shut inter-switch trunks, no PC PortFast, ready VLAN/host settings and zero credit

Published IOS commands select Rapid PVST before enabling each switch trunk, set complementary primary/secondary priorities, save all startup configurations and avoid creating legacy-peer migration state

Eight live configuration/election/port-role tasks precede actual traffic; observed replies from both same-VLAN pairs complete all ten tasks, reverse traffic works and cross-VLAN traffic stays isolated
Actual BPDU vectors elect SW1 for VLAN 10 and SW2 for VLAN 20 on every switch; dropping all STP advertisements prevents root and rapid-role credit despite accepted configuration

SW3 VLAN 10 uses Gi0/23 Root FWD and Gi0/24 Altn BLK; VLAN 20 uses the opposite roles. Tagged ICMP frames leave only the forwarding uplink, preserve IP TTL and never transmit user traffic through the alternate port
Either SW3 uplink can fail while both VLAN pairs reconverge over the remaining link; restoring it returns the original complementary roots and alternate roles
Both SW3 uplinks down isolate the sources; core-link failure instead preserves an alternate loop-free path through SW3 with both VLAN pairs working
SW2 takes over VLAN 10 when SW1 fails; SW1 takes over VLAN 20 when SW2 fails. The surviving same-VLAN endpoints remain reachable, and saved primary priorities reclaim their roots after recovery
Classic PVST can forward after its delays but cannot satisfy Rapid PVST mode or point-to-point rapid-port checks
A mixed classic peer creates real legacy detection; after all peers use Rapid PVST, the documented clear spanning-tree detected-protocols command restores rapid operation
Root macros set configured priorities once: a later superior bridge can win the election without the original root dynamically defending its priority
A per-VLAN path-cost override changes the affected preferred uplink and role credit while the other VLAN stays correctly rooted; automatic cost restoration recovers the intended path
Portable saves retain priorities, stable device IDs and earned echo observations while live root and port states rebuild from fresh BPDUs; startup power cycles preserve the saved configuration

Every published show/ping command works; output exposes protocol rstp, primary root priorities 24586/24596 including the VLAN system ID, P2p Edge only at endpoints, Root FWD and Altn BLK roles, blocked segments and learned MACs

Imported mode, priority, root and port criteria validate bounded VLANs, multiples of 4096, supported states/roles and booleans, and cannot match unknown roots, inactive interfaces or nonswitch default settings
scope: Uses the existing BPDU, STP, Ethernet and packet engines. Adds the lab and declarative guide criteria; no new protocol commands, simulation-engine changes or server dependencies. Failover exercises use existing CLI and traffic controls; restore both uplinks for full live role credit. No guarantee of zero packet loss during convergence, and no CML validation is claimed for this catalog addition.
